title: 2026-11-22 — A lock move is proven by a locked build, not by the audit leg

data.head: ## 2026-11-22 — A lock move is proven by a locked build, not by the audit leg

body: The audit leg reads `Cargo.lock` against advisories and licences alone, so a lock the workspace cannot compile on reads `advisories ok, licenses ok`. A `cargo update -p url` meant to close one advisory also re-resolved two `syn` edges, and the lock it wrote failed to build `bindgen` — measured only at implement, because the plan's lock move had been measured by the audit leg alone.

Measure every lock move — a targeted `cargo update`, an upstream sync's take — by `cargo build --workspace --locked --all-targets` (or a leg that builds the workspace) as well as by the audit leg, and read the lock's diff for edges beyond the packages meant to move.

A behaviour-preserving refactor: escher's own additions in three upstream engine functions were moved out into private functions of escher's own, with one call left in upstream's body.
The accessibility node builder now reads aria-expanded, aria-selected, aria-label, toggle and invalid states through escher's own writer functions, each ARIA attribute still read once.
The keyboard handler's control-key arms (range, single list box, drop-down, multiple select, Enter activation) and the close-the-open-list-before-Tab step moved into two private functions, in their former order and gates; the control-key function stands before upstream's text-input arm and returns early on an element holding text-input data.
The list-box presentational hints (a select's size height, a single list box's overflow-y auto, the list-box row blocks) moved into one private function.
The driver's command validation tests moved whole into their own file; the url and form_urlencoded lock versions were bumped, closing an audit advisory; all a11y, fast, coverage and audit legs and CI green, behaviour unchanged.

body_fields.what: the accessibility tree builder — the node builder that sets each element's role, name and ARIA states (expanded, selected, pressed, checked, toggled, invalid) on the AccessKit node

the engine's keyboard event handling — Tab and Shift+Tab focus moves, closing an open select list before Tab, range input keys, single list box, drop-down and multiple select keys, Enter and Space activation
the presentational hints computation — a select's size attribute height, a single list box's overflow-y auto and the list-box row blocks
the driver's command validation — the verb table, a call checked at its own level, a malformed call refused with the rule it broke
the driver command validation's unit tests, moved whole out of the validation module
the workspace dependency lock — url and form_urlencoded versions, the dependency audit's input

body: The one-read-per-ARIA-attribute decision: the reads of aria-expanded, aria-selected and aria-label now stand in escher's own writer functions called once from the node builder; each attribute is still read once across the builder and those functions.

The decisions that ARIA states are written on every element and that the accessibility tree is built through the document's own method: the node builder keeps its signature and single caller, its states now written through one call right after the role is set.
The ARIA property read contract item aria-expanded and the single-select-expanded-from-its-list decisions: the expanded write moved into its own writer function, unchanged in value.

The accessibility tree states contract items aria-selected, select option, aria-pressed, aria-checked, native checkbox or radio and aria-invalid, and the toggle-state-read-by-role and native-checkable-toggle decisions: the selected, toggled and invalid reads moved into escher's own functions, values and closed lower-case matches unchanged.

The accessible name contract item aria-label and the accessible-name-precedence and aria-labelledby-outranks-label decisions: the aria-label name write moved into its own function, precedence unchanged.

The keyboard activation contract items Enter, Space and handler order, and the Enter-and-Space-activate-as-a-click decision: Enter activation is now one arm of a private control-key function called before upstream's text-input arm, which returns early on a text-input element so exactly one of them acts, as before.
The range input key contract items and the range-input-keys decision: the range arm moved into the control-key function, its disabled gate and keys unchanged.

The single-choice select list closed and list open key contract items, the single list box keys item and the multiple select keys item: their arms moved into the control-key function in their former order and gates.
The Tab-chooses-the-row-and-closes-the-list-first decision and the single-choice select list open Tab contract item: the close-before-Tab step is now its own private function called in the Tab arm.
The select key change fires one input then one change decision and the select list choices share one write path decision: the key arms that make those writes moved, the writes unchanged.

The open select list rows take one height and select list coverage headless decisions, as they rest on the list-box presentational hints: the size height, overflow-y auto and row blocks are now pushed by one private function, which reads every size attribute of the select as the loop did.
The a11y CI leg and accessibility-test-leg decisions: the leg was fired as the behaviour guard of the moved bodies and stayed green; its rows hold no changed value.

The accessibility tree contract items for a single select's expanded and select role, and the snapshot rows that take readings from the tree: their source writes moved functions only, the readings unchanged.
Contrast and visual lint rows — the WCAG contrast ratio, thresholds, lint findings, stand accent colour and scrollbar thumb stroke: no colour, ratio or lint reading moved.
Snapshot text form, actions answer, handler coverage, UI graph, MCP results and node id rows: no snapshot field, driver answer shape or served id changed.
Platform adapter and feature-gate rows — AccessKit adapter creation order, accesskit_xplat, accessibility default-on, no adapter on the stand binaries: no feature, adapter or binary changed.
Pointer and click rows — synthetic click, double click threshold, range pointerdown and click, checkable click toggles, label click, driver click refusals and hit-testing: no pointer path moved.
Focusability and focus fixup rows — what is focusable, focus-visible, focus-within, removed focused node, inert focus fixup: no focus rule changed.
The seven_guis Cells grid and CRUD list contract items and the Dioxus document reached-handler record: no app or Dioxus document code changed.
Cognitive accessibility, stand tab order table, stand checks repeated three rounds and the not-yet-measured overview notes of every area: nothing measured or added there.

A behaviour-preserving refactor in the Epoch 2 corrective: escher's own additions moved out of three upstream blitz-dom function bodies into private functions of escher's own, one call each in upstream's body.
The accessibility node builder now calls one escher function for its ARIA states (expanded, name, selected, toggled, invalid); the keyboard event handler calls one function for its control-key chain (range, single list box, drop-down, multiple select, Enter activation) and one that closes an open select list before Tab; the presentational-hints pass calls one function for a list-box select's size height and overflow.
The escher-driver command module's inline unit tests moved whole into a child test file declared by a path attribute; the seven tests keep their command::tests paths and no production item moved.
Measured: command module 848 to 249 code lines; cognitive complexity of the three upstream functions 50 to 13, 58 to 46, 176 to 167, the highest fork-own function 14; escher-driver line coverage 97.97 to 97.80 percent against its floor 97; stand duplication 44 pairs and 372 lines under the 47 and 550 bar.
The lock moved url 2.5.8 to 2.5.9 and form_urlencoded 1.2.2 to 1.2.3, closing advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0592 with no audit ignore added; on the operator's ruling the bindgen and cssparser-macros syn edges stay at 3.0.6, because the lock cargo update -p url writes does not build.
No public symbol, schema, config, CI workflow or dev-tool version changed; nothing retired.

Keyboard rules over the moved control-key chain: decision/select-keyboard-model, decision/range-keyboard, decision/keyboard-activation-enter, decision/multiple-select-row-keys, decision/select-list-tab-chooses-and-closes, contract/select-list-default-actions/tab, contract/select-list-default-actions/open-keys, contract/dom-events/range-input-default, contract/event-dispatch/enter-click: same arms, order and gates; the chain now runs before upstream's text-input arm and returns early on a text-input element.

decision/select-size-hint, decision/single-select-list-box and decision/legacy-attributes-as-pres-hints: the select size height hint, the single list box's overflow-y auto and its row blocks now come from one escher function after the hints loop; it reads every size attribute of the select, not only the first.

decision/direct-engine-changes-flagged-upstreamable, decision/select-list-engine-change, decision/select-model-engine-change and decision/a11y-input-focus-engine-changes: escher's direct engine changes in the three bodies are now isolated as one call each in upstream's text.

decision/per-crate-coverage-floors, decision/per-crate-coverage-floor and decision/coverage-floors: escher-driver coverage reading moved 97.97 to 97.80 percent; the floor 97 these rows hold stands and holds.

decision/dependency-and-licence-audit, decision/cargo-deny-advisory-gate and decision/cargo-deny-audit: advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0592 closed by url 2.5.9, no ignore added, the audit leg reads advisories ok and licenses ok.

decision/locked-cargo-legs and decision/cargo-legs-locked: the committed lock is not what cargo resolves for a url update (syn edges held at 3.0.6); every locked leg builds on it; a later url update re-breaks the build until bindgen and prettyplease agree on syn.
decision/workspace-dependencies, decision/workspace-shared-dependencies and decision/no-git-dependencies: the bump touched the lock alone, no manifest and no dependency added.

decision/validated-commands-only, contract/verb-table/order, contract/validation-order/first-failure and contract/driver-session/command-schema: the command module's production items unchanged; only their unit tests moved file.
decision/spec-url-citations and decision/rustdoc-warnings-are-errors: the moved spec links are now doc comments with angle-bracketed URLs to satisfy rustdoc bare_urls, text unchanged.

decision/upstream-sync-by-two-parent-merge and decision/upstream-sync-merge-base: upstream's three function bodies now differ from upstream's text only by escher's call lines, which narrows future merge conflicts in them.

body_fields.fact: A fork addition to an upstream function over the cognitive complexity ceiling goes into a function of escher's own, with one call in upstream's body (as push_inline_box already is); the founder's ruling, beside the ceiling decision.

The chunk moves escher's additions out of three upstream bodies (accessibility states, keyboard control keys, list-box hints) and the command tests into their own file with behaviour unchanged (fct-zmo72vim, fct-ysuprmlb, fct-irf3vy6k); it adds no UI surface or region (fct-rkpgmslu, D-layout-surface quiet), so every picked row, the stale-marked keyboard, select, id and accessibility rows included, still reads true, and the task brings no fact.

body_fields.name: Fork additions in functions of escher's own
body_fields.rule: A fork addition to an upstream function over the cognitive complexity ceiling goes into a function of escher's own, with one call in upstream's body.
body_fields.because: The standing rule the CARRY cry-6gvl75lk names, on the founder's word of 2026-11-22 «Выносить наши добавки в хелперы (Recommended)» (inputs#I7, relayed in the operator's wrap directive inputs#I6); the chunk brought build_accessibility_node, handle_key_or_input_event and compute_presentational_hints to that form.

body_fields.name: bindgen and cssparser-macros syn edges held in the lock
body_fields.rule: The lockfile holds the syn edges of bindgen and cssparser-macros at 3.0.6, against cargo's own re-resolution, until bindgen and prettyplease agree on syn; a url update that moves them breaks the locked build.
body_fields.why: bindgen 0.73.2 fails to build against syn 2.0.119, the version a url update re-resolves those edges to.
body_fields.because: The chunk's lock keeps both syn edges at 3.0.6 where cargo would move them, a standing hold on the lock that future dependency updates must respect, and no row of the section says it.

body_fields.name: A lock move proven by the locked build
body_fields.rule: A lockfile move is proven by the locked workspace build as well as by the audit leg; the audit leg alone proves no build.
body_fields.why: A lock the audit leg passed did not compile.
body_fields.because: The chunk found that a lock move checked by the audit leg alone did not build, a rule for every later lock move that no standing row of the section states.

body_fields.name: Lock move measured by the locked build
body_fields.rule: A change of the lockfile is measured by the locked workspace build as well as by the audit leg; an audit-only reading of a moved lock proves no build.
body_fields.why: The audit leg reads the lock against advisories and licenses alone, so a lock the workspace cannot compile on reads green there.
body_fields.because: A lock move measured by the audit leg alone read green while the workspace did not compile on it, so the gate a lock move owes must name the locked build too.

body:
A behaviour-preserving structural corrective: the driver's command validation module had its inline unit tests moved whole into a child test module file, its production items unchanged.
Three upstream engine functions (the accessibility node builder, the keyboard event handler and the presentational hints computation) had escher's own additions moved out into private functions of escher's own, one call each in upstream's body; every read, arm, gate and order is kept, each ARIA attribute read once.
The lockfile moved url 2.5.8 to 2.5.9 and form_urlencoded 1.2.2 to 1.2.3, closing advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0592 with no audit ignore added; the audit leg reads advisories ok, licenses ok and CI went green.
The bindgen and cssparser-macros syn edges were held at 3.0.6 against cargo's own re-resolution on the operator's ruling, because the lock cargo update -p url writes does not build (E0277 in bindgen); the workspace builds locked on the lock carried.
Measured: escher-driver line coverage 97.97 to 97.80 percent against its floor 97; no public symbol, verb, contract, schema or config changed.

body_fields.what: the driver's single command validation gate, the closed driver verb schema checked call by call with refusal by the first broken rule; edited, its inline unit tests replaced by a path to a child test module
the unit tests of the driver command validation gate (admitted calls, unknown verbs, malformed calls, refusal order, verb levels); new, moved whole from the gate's module

the accessibility tree builder feeding the accessibility adapter, reading ARIA control states (expanded, selected, toggled, invalid) and the accessible name, aria-label trimmed once; edited, escher's reads moved into its own private functions

the engine keyboard event handling, with Tab closing an open select list, range input key actions, single list box and drop-down select keys, multiple select keys and Enter activation of the focused control; edited, escher's arms moved into its own private functions
the presentational hint attributes read by a typed parse, including a select's size hint rows and a single list box's overflow; edited, the select size arm moved into a private function
the lockfile read by locked builds and by the cargo-deny audit leg on every push; edited, url and form_urlencoded bumped, syn edges of bindgen and cssparser-macros held

body: The dependency audit CI gate and cargo-deny as the audit tool: advisory RUSTSEC-2026-0592 closed by the url 2.5.9 bump, the audit leg green with advisories ok, licenses ok.
Advisory ignores by ID and audit ignores with a written reason: no ignore added; the advisory was closed by a version move instead.

Locked builds: the lock carried is one cargo's own re-resolution does not produce (syn edges of bindgen and cssparser-macros held at 3.0.6), yet the workspace builds and reads metadata under --locked with the lock unchanged.

Engine dependency pins, upstream sync taking the dependency set whole and workspace-inherited dependency versions: a lock-only bump, no manifest touched, and two transitive syn edges held against resolution.
The absence of automated dependency update tooling: the residual hazard that a later url update re-breaks the build until bindgen and prettyplease agree on syn stands beside it.
The dependency-security overview's lockfile advisory state read on every push: the advisory state of the lock moved (one advisory closed).
Per-crate line coverage floors: escher-driver's reading moved 97.97 to 97.80 percent; its floor 97 holds and is unchanged.

Single command validation gate, closed driver verb schema, fixed order of target refusals and the driver refusal causes: the gate's module was restructured (tests moved out), its validation and refusal behaviour unchanged.

One trimmed aria-label read, aria-labelledby outranking label and aria-label, toggle state read per role, closed parse of expanded, disabled and level, and control states crossing as closed values: the reads moved into escher's own builder functions, each attribute read once, values unchanged.
Select expansion from engine state only and where a select's choice leaves: the expanded and selected state reads moved into escher's own functions, unchanged.
Content classes on the accessibility adapter crossing and ratified exits of accessible names: the name reader moved, the crossing unchanged.

Range input key actions, select keys passing a closed match, single select list keys, multiple select keys and clicks, and Enter activating the focused control: the five-arm key chain moved into one function of escher's own in its former order and gates.
Tab chooses and closes an open select list and what closes an open select list: the Tab close moved into its own function, called before upstream's Tab handling as before.

Select size hint capped, multiple select size sets its rows and presentational hints read by a typed parse: the select size arm moved into its own function; it now iterates every size attribute of the select, as the loop's arm did.

body_fields.fact: The lockfile holds bindgen's and cssparser-macros' syn edges at 3.0.6 against cargo's own re-resolution (operator ruling), since bindgen 0.73.2 fails to build against syn 2.0.119; a later url update re-breaks the build until bindgen and prettyplease agree on syn.
A lock move is proven by the locked workspace build as well as the audit leg; the audit leg alone proves no build.
